arguments.body:
CANARY_0926fdfaa4fc

Thank you for reporting this issue. Based on your description, this appears to be a regression as it occurs after an upgrade and causes the app to crash immediately on startup. 

Severity: **High** — The crash on boot makes the application unusable for affected users.

Next Steps:
- Please provide additional details such as the app version, OS/platform, stack trace or error logs (if available), and any steps to reproduce the crash. This information will help us diagnose and fix the issue more quickly.

The team has been notified of this regression and will investigate further. If you have additional information, please share it in this issue thread. Thank you!
